4-5 | @WWJFC

87’ | GOAL! @SamuelS78281970 plays the through-ball straight in behind of the Winstanley defence. 10’s shot initially gets saved by the goalkeeper but he’s soon there to score the rebound. 👊

4-5 | @WWJFC

79’ | GOAL! @LJMoran98 with another pre-season goal. Otono nicely caught the rebound to play the ball across to Moran who scores. 👍

3-5 | @WWJFC

77’ | Glendon nets from inside the box. 

2-5 | @WWJFC

73’ | Winstanley’s lead increase back to 2 as their recent substitute trivellas the shot into the far corner.

2-4 | @WWJFC

69’ | GOAL! A few disappointing clearances from Winstanley and 10 is there to header into an empty net! 👏

2-3 | @WWJFC

65’ | @LJMoran98 whips in the cross finding Dear but the header glances wide at the near post.

Still in this! ✊

1-3 | @WWJFC

57’ | @ThomasFreear makes a good save down low stopping the 1 on 1. 👊

Shortly before, Alsager made plenty of changes, around 3/4 in total. 🔄

1-3 | @WWJFC

52’ | Glendon extends the lead for Winstanley as the mis-placed shot bounces awkwardly off the post and in.

1-3 | @WWJFC

46’ | Back underway. 👊

1-2 | @WWJFC

HT’ | The bullets trail at the break. Still plenty of time to get back in this. 

1-2 | @WWJFC

42’ | Fitton is shown the red card after a late challenge. The referee’s allowed the game to continue with @SamuelS78281970 replacing Fitton as a substitution instead.

1-2 | @WWJFC

29’ | Decent try by @LJMoran98 from the free-kick. It ends up curling awkwardly for the keeper who tips it over for a corner.

Rogers then has a chance from the corner with the keeper missing the ball but there was just too many bodies in the way! 😩

1-2 | @WWJFC

19’ | Almost straight after the equaliser, Winstanley’s 9 nets from a 1 on 1 position. Alsager now trail.

1-2 | @WWJFC

17’ | GOAL! Instant response! 🤩

Renshaw with the flick-on into the bottom corner which was nicely found by @jordyfitton95’s cross from the corner. 

1-1 | @WWJFC

12’ | Just coming up to the first third of the half. Despite Alsager netting first which ended up being disallowed, Winstanley are first to score.
